alt: Blue keyboard with four rows of mechanical keys mounted on conveyor belts, a hand reaching toward the scrolling keys
story: Google Japan released an open-source concept keyboard where 116 keys ride on 4 continuous conveyor belts rotating toward the user's fingers so you never move your hand, but the firmware section for actually sending key presses to a computer is marked 'TBD.'
why_funny: The solution to not wanting to move your fingers is an elaborate conveyor system — and it doesn't even fully work yet.
